entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.dialogueText: “Her name is Manoly Suheil.”

entries.dialogueText: “She is popular both in the Assembly and among the people.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.speaker: Player

entries.menuText: “What can she do when Frens couldn't do anything?”

entries.dialogueText: “Hypothetically, what if she were to meet the same fate as Frens?”

entries.dialogueText: “Make sure he never becomes a big problem, then.”
entries.menuText: “Make sure he never becomes a big problem, then.”

entries.dialogueText: “On top of that, he has a fervent following among the Young Sords.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I can say with certainty that he *..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can say with certainty that he *will* be a problem.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I never cared for either man. But..."
entries.dialogueText: “I never cared for either man. But you may be right.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We will do our best.”"
